# Known exceptions to TestModulesUseOnlyTheSPI, shrink-only debt (docs/architecture/core-and-modules.md "Guards"): a
# module that still imports a stateful core package, as "<module id> <core package>" for any of its files or
# "<module id> (test) <core package>" for its tests only. A line no import needs fails the test. Never add one to make
# a new import pass when a contract, a leaf library or a port would do; no wildcards.
#
# The GitHub connector's tests run it through the connector framework as the manager does: the registry and the
# write gate (chatrule_test.go, gate_args_test.go), the connector-protocol conformance suite (conformance_test.go) and
# the subscription service (inbox_things_test.go). They use the module's unexported fixtures, so they stay in the
# module until those fixtures are a stand-in (internal/modules/github/githubtest) a core test can use (#13936).
github (test) internal/connector
github (test) internal/connector/conformance
github (test) internal/subscriptions
#
# Meeting recording keeps the recordings' storage in the knowledge base (the kb.Recording model with its Engine and
# Store), which stays in the core until kb offers a recording port (#13407).
recording internal/kb
